details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: symlink traversal during sandbox setup lets a crafted
     source tree redirect file/dir creation and mounts outside the sandbox
     (sandbox escape)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-87766.patch: resolve every destination inside
       /newroot and every source inside /oldroot a component at a time
       (safe_openat in utils.c), create and mount through O_PATH|O_NOFOLLOW fds
       passed to the privileged helper (bind_mount_fd), and refuse to mount on
       a symlink destination (bubblewrap.c, bind-mount.c, utils.c)
     - CVE-2026-87766
